name: Barber Park

attributes.Descriptions: Beach stairs and boat ramp areas designated for launching from Barber Park. The beach area includes an ADA compliant concrete ramp.
attributes.Name: Barber Park Put-In

reviewNote: The official public-access map identifies this designated landing; satellite review places it at the beach/stair access, not in a parking lot. Launch only during the official float season after the river is opened.
imageryReview: ArcGIS World Imagery, reviewed 2026-10-29; no coordinate moved to imagery. Approximate facility markers remain approximate.

name: Ann Morrison Park

attributes.Descriptions: All floaters must exit the river here. Floating beyond this point is extremely dangerous and should not be attempted. An ADA compliant concrete ramp is located just downstream on river-left.
attributes.Name: Last Chance Take-Out Ann Morrison Park

reviewNote: The official public-access map identifies this designated landing; satellite review places it at the beach/stair access, not in a parking lot. All floaters must exit at Ann Morrison Park; the diversion dam downstream is dangerous.
imageryReview: ArcGIS World Imagery, reviewed 2026-10-29; no coordinate moved to imagery. Approximate facility markers remain approximate.
